## Summary
Build the question remixing service that generates assessment item variants from approved source items, preserving the SubConcept connection while varying the clinical scenario and optionally targeting a different Bloom level.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want to generate variants of an approved question at a different Bloom level or with a different clinical scenario, so that I can expand my item bank without writing questions from scratch and prevent student memorization across exam cycles.

## Why this matters
Item banks become stale when the same questions recirculate. Students share questions across cohorts, making reuse unreliable for valid assessment. Remix generation preserves the validated SubConcept mapping while creating novel clinical presentations, dramatically reducing faculty authoring burden. Without proper sanitization (Rule 5), source item content could be used for prompt injection attacks on the generation model.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] POST /api/items/[id]/remix generates a variant of the source item
- [ ] Request specifies target_bloom_level (1-6) and optionally a clinical_context hint
- [ ] Generated variant shares same SubConcept as source item
- [ ] Generated variant uses a different clinical scenario than source
- [ ] Generated variant enters the system as 'draft' status (requires QA approval)
- [ ] Variant carries parent_item_id FK linking back to source item
- [ ] Source item content is sanitized via sanitizeForContext before LLM prompt (Rule 5)
- [ ] LLM call uses SONNET_MODEL constant for generation (Rule 4)
- [ ] LLM response parsed with safeJsonParse (Rule 2)
- [ ] Max 5 variants per source item (validation enforced)
- [ ] Variant written to Supabase first, then Neo4j sync (Rule 6)
- [ ] API returns 403 for non-faculty roles
- [ ] API returns 404 for nonexistent source item
- [ ] API returns 409 if source item already has 5 variants

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 2 (H06) | safeJsonParse for Claude's generated variant JSON — never raw JSON.parse |
| Rule 4 (D05) | SONNET_MODEL for remix generation (core generation task) |
| Rule 5 (H12) | sanitizeForContext + buildContextBlock for source item in prompt |
| Rule 6 (G08) | Write variant to Supabase first, Neo4j second |
| Rule 1 (C05) | neo4jQuery for reading source item hub connections |
| D06 | Variant must eventually connect all three hubs before entering practice pool |

## Neo4j nodes created/modified
| Node type | Properties set | Created or modified? |
|---|---|---|
| AssessmentItem (variant) | uuid, stem, choices, bloom_level, status:'draft', parent_item_id | Created (via Supabase-first dual-write) |

## Neo4j edges created/traversed
| Edge | From -> To | Properties | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| COVERS | AssessmentItem (variant) -> SubConcept | — | Inherited from source item |
| VARIANT_OF | AssessmentItem (variant) -> AssessmentItem (source) | — | Lineage tracking |
| COVERS | AssessmentItem (source) -> SubConcept | — | Read to inherit connection |
| ALIGNS_TO | AssessmentItem (source) -> SLO | — | Read for context (variant may get different SLO) |
| MAPPED_TO | AssessmentItem (source) -> USMLE_Subtopic | — | Read for context |

## Inngest event context
None — synchronous single-item remix (not a batch operation).
If batch remix is needed later, it would use Promise.allSettled (Rule 3).

## API contract
```
POST /api/items/[id]/remix
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Request: {
  target_bloom_level: number (1-6),
  clinical_context?: string  // optional hint for the clinical scenario
}
Response: {
  data: {
    variant: {
      id: string,
      parent_item_id: string,
      stem: string,
      choices: Array<{ id: string, text: string }>,
      correct_answer: string,
      explanation: string,
      bloom_level: number,
      status: 'draft',
      subconcept: { id: string, name: string }
    }
  },
  error: null
}
Error: {
  data: null,
  error: {
    code: 'NOT_FOUND' | 'FORBIDDEN' | 'MAX_VARIANTS' | 'GENERATION_FAILED',
    message: string
  }
}
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/item-generation/services/RemixService.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'      // Rule 1
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'
import { safeJsonParse } from '@journey/ai/safe-parse'   // Rule 2
import { SONNET_MODEL } from '@journey/ai/constants'      // Rule 4
import { sanitizeForContext, buildContextBlock } from '@journey/ai/sanitize'  // Rule 5

export class RemixService {
  async remix(sourceItemId: string, targetBloom: number, clinicalHint?: string) {
    const supabase = createServerClient()

    // 1. Load source item from Supabase
    const { data: source } = await supabase
      .from('assessment_items')
      .select('*')
      .eq('id', sourceItemId)
      .single()

    // 2. Check variant cap
    if (source!.variant_count >= 5) {
      throw new MaxVariantsError(sourceItemId)
    }

    // 3. Load source hub connections from Neo4j (Rule 1)
    const hubs = await neo4jQuery<HubConnections[]>(`
      MATCH (ai:AssessmentItem {uuid: $id})-[:COVERS]->(sc:SubConcept)
      OPTIONAL MATCH (ai)-[:ALIGNS_TO]->(slo:SLO)
      OPTIONAL MATCH (ai)-[:MAPPED_TO]->(st:USMLE_Subtopic)
      RETURN sc, slo, st
    `, { id: sourceItemId })

    // 4. Build sanitized prompt (Rule 5)
    const sanitizedStem = sanitizeForContext(source!.stem)
    const context = buildContextBlock('source_item', sanitizedStem)

    // 5. Call Claude with SONNET_MODEL (Rule 4)
    const response = await anthropic.messages.create({
      model: SONNET_MODEL,
      messages: [{ role: 'user', content: remixPrompt(context, targetBloom, clinicalHint) }]
    })

    // 6. Parse response safely (Rule 2)
    const { data: variant } = safeJsonParse<VariantData>(response.content[0].text)

    // 7. Write to Supabase FIRST (Rule 6)
    const { data: saved } = await supabase
      .from('assessment_items')
      .insert({
        ...variant,
        parent_item_id: sourceItemId,
        status: 'draft',
        bloom_level: targetBloom
      })
      .select()
      .single()

    // 8. Atomically increment variant_count (Rule 11 pattern)
    await supabase.rpc('increment_variant_count', { item_id: sourceItemId })

    // 9. Sync to Neo4j SECOND (failure logged, never blocks) (Rule 6)
    try {
      await neo4jQuery(`
        CREATE (v:AssessmentItem {uuid: $variantId, parent_item_id: $sourceId, status: 'draft'})
        WITH v
        MATCH (sc:SubConcept {uuid: $subconceptId})
        CREATE (v)-[:COVERS]->(sc)
        CREATE (v)-[:VARIANT_OF]->(:AssessmentItem {uuid: $sourceId})
      `, { variantId: saved!.id, sourceId: sourceItemId, subconceptId: hubs[0].sc.uuid })
    } catch (e) {
      // Log Neo4j sync failure — will be retried by weekly reconciliation job
      console.error('Neo4j sync failed for variant', saved!.id, e)
    }

    return saved
  }
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-02: Raw JSON.parse on Claude response (Rule 2)
const variant = JSON.parse(response.content[0].text)  // CRASHES on ~1-3% of responses

// ✗ AP-04: Hardcoded model string (Rule 4)
model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514'  // BANNED — use SONNET_MODEL

// ✗ AP-05: Unsanitized content in LLM prompt (Rule 5)
const prompt = `Remix this item: ${source.stem}`  // PROMPT INJECTION VECTOR

// ✗ Rule 6: Neo4j before Supabase
await neo4jQuery('CREATE (v:AssessmentItem ...)')  // WRONG ORDER
await supabase.from('assessment_items').insert(...)

// ✗ AP-03: Promise.all for batch remix (if batch is ever added)
await Promise.all(items.map(i => remix(i)))  // BANNED — use Promise.allSettled

// ✗ Non-atomic variant count increment (Rule 11 pattern)
const { variant_count } = await supabase.from('assessment_items').select('variant_count').eq('id', id).single()
await supabase.from('assessment_items').update({ variant_count: variant_count + 1 })
// WRONG — race condition. Use RPC: SET variant_count = variant_count + 1
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E06/E06-S07.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const BASE = process.env.BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3000'

test('Acceptance: POST /api/items/[id]/remix generates variant', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/items/${process.env.TEST_ITEM_ID}/remix`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: { target_bloom_level: 4 }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200)
  const { data } = await res.json()
  expect(data.variant.parent_item_id).toBe(process.env.TEST_ITEM_ID)
  expect(data.variant.bloom_level).toBe(4)
  expect(data.variant.status).toBe('draft')
})

test('Acceptance: variant shares SubConcept with source', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/items/${process.env.TEST_ITEM_ID}/remix`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: { target_bloom_level: 2 }
  })
  const { data } = await res.json()
  // Fetch source item's subconcept
  const sourceRes = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/items/${process.env.TEST_ITEM_ID}`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  const { data: source } = await sourceRes.json()
  expect(data.variant.subconcept.id).toBe(source.hubs.subconcept.id)
})

test('Acceptance: variant has different stem than source', async ({ request }) => {
  const sourceRes = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/items/${process.env.TEST_ITEM_ID}`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  const { data: source } = await sourceRes.json()

  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/items/${process.env.TEST_ITEM_ID}/remix`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: { target_bloom_level: 3 }
  })
  const { data } = await res.json()
  expect(data.variant.stem).not.toBe(source.stem)
})

test('Negative: max 5 variants enforced', async ({ request }) => {
  // Assumes TEST_MAXED_ITEM_ID already has 5 variants
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/items/${process.env.TEST_MAXED_ITEM_ID}/remix`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: { target_bloom_level: 1 }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(409)
  const { error } = await res.json()
  expect(error.code).toBe('MAX_VARIANTS')
})

test('Negative: non-faculty gets 403', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/items/${process.env.TEST_ITEM_ID}/remix`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_STUDENT_TOKEN}` },
    data: { target_bloom_level: 3 }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(403)
})

test('Negative: nonexistent source item gets 404', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/items/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/remix`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: { target_bloom_level: 3 }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(404)
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `ALTER TABLE assessment_items DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS parent_item_id; ALTER TABLE assessment_items DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS variant_count; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_assessment_items_parent;` then `pnpm db:types`
2. Neo4j: `MATCH ()-[r:VARIANT_OF]->() DELETE r` (remove variant edges)
3. Remove files: `rm app/api/items/\[id\]/remix/route.ts features/item-generation/services/RemixService.ts packages/ai/prompts/remix.md`
4. `git stash && git checkout develop`
